jobs.title: Part-Time Hospital Security Officer – Patrol & Access Control
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Part-Time Security Officer Hospital Patrol in Houston, TX. You will provide customer service to patients, visitors, and staff while enforcing site procedures in a healthcare setting.

The role emphasizes vigilance, calm problem-solving, and clear communication with responders and leadership. Responsibilities include patrolling designated areas, monitoring access, and reporting incidents.

jobs.description:

The officer will rotate between posts as needed and serve as the first point of contact for tenants, guests, and vendors, upholding professionalism and reliability throughout the day.
